_comment: DHCPv6 option, message-type and status-code names, after the IANA 'Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol for IPv6 (DHCPv6)' registries (https://www.iana.org/assignments/dhcpv6-parameters/). `format` (see dhcpv6.rs's format_value) tells the UI how to render an option's value; options without one fall back to a hex dump, and codes not listed at all are shown as 'Unknown option N'. `description` + `rfc` drive the hover tooltip on the option name in the DHCP tab; both are only set where confidently known. Add or improve any of these fields here; no Rust changes needed.

options.name: Client Identifier
options.description: Identifies the client by its DUID.

options.name: Server Identifier
options.description: Identifies the server by its DUID.

options.name: Identity Association for Non-temporary Addresses (IA_NA)
options.description: Container for the non-temporary addresses of one identity association (IAID, T1, T2 and the addresses).

options.name: Identity Association for Temporary Addresses (IA_TA)
options.description: Container for the temporary addresses of one identity association.

options.name: IA Address
options.description: One address with its preferred and valid lifetimes; normally nested inside an IA_NA or IA_TA.

options.name: Option Request
options.description: The options the client asks the server to send.

options.name: Preference
options.description: How strongly this server is preferred; 255 makes the client pick it immediately.

options.name: Elapsed Time
options.description: Time since the client began this exchange, in hundredths of a second.

options.name: Relay Message
options.description: The message a relay agent forwards (RELAY-FORW) or delivers (RELAY-REPL).

options.name: Authentication
options.description: Authentication information for the message.

options.name: Server Unicast
options.description: Address the client may use to send messages directly to this server instead of multicast.

options.name: Status Code
options.description: Outcome of the request, with an optional text message.

options.name: Rapid Commit
options.description: Asks for (or confirms) the two-message exchange Solicit/Reply instead of the usual four.

options.name: User Class
options.description: Opaque strings describing the kind of user or application the client belongs to.

options.name: Vendor Class
options.description: The vendor's enterprise number and class data identifying the client's hardware or software.

options.name: Vendor-specific Information
options.description: Vendor-defined sub-options, scoped by the vendor's enterprise number.

options.name: Interface-Id
options.description: Added by a relay agent to identify the interface a message arrived on.

options.name: Reconfigure Message
options.description: Which message the client should send after a RECONFIGURE (Renew or Information-request).

options.name: Reconfigure Accept
options.description: Tells the server the client accepts RECONFIGURE messages.

options.name: SIP Servers Domain Name List
options.description: Domain names of SIP outbound proxy servers.

options.name: SIP Servers IPv6 Address List
options.description: Addresses of SIP outbound proxy servers.

options.name: DNS Recursive Name Server
options.description: Addresses of DNS resolvers, in order of preference.

options.name: Domain Search List
options.description: Domain names to append when resolving short names.

options.name: Identity Association for Prefix Delegation (IA_PD)
options.description: Container for the delegated prefixes of one identity association (IAID, T1, T2 and the prefixes).

options.name: IA Prefix
options.description: One delegated prefix with its preferred and valid lifetimes; normally nested inside an IA_PD.

options.name: NIS Servers
options.description: Addresses of NIS servers.

options.name: NIS+ Servers
options.description: Addresses of NIS+ servers.

options.name: NIS Domain Name
options.description: The client's NIS domain.

options.name: NIS+ Domain Name
options.description: The client's NIS+ domain.

options.name: SNTP Servers
options.description: Addresses of SNTP time servers.

options.name: Information Refresh Time
options.description: How long a client using stateless configuration may keep the information before asking again.

options.name: BCMCS Controller Domain Name List
options.description: Domain names of broadcast/multicast service controllers.

options.name: BCMCS Controller IPv6 Address List
options.description: Addresses of broadcast/multicast service controllers.

options.name: Client FQDN
options.description: The client's fully qualified domain name, with flags saying who updates DNS.

options.name: New POSIX Timezone
options.description: Time zone as a POSIX TZ string.

options.name: New TZDB Timezone
options.description: Time zone as an IANA tz database name.

options.name: Echo Request
options.description: Options the server should echo back in its reply.

options.name: NTP Server
options.description: NTP server location (address, multicast address or FQDN) as sub-options.

options.name: Boot File URL
options.description: URL of the boot file for network boot.

options.name: Boot File Parameters
options.description: Parameters for the boot file, as length-prefixed strings.

options.name: Client System Architecture Type
options.description: Architecture types of the client system, for network boot.

options.name: Client Network Interface Identifier
options.description: Network interface type and version of the client, for network boot.

options.name: AFTR-Name
options.description: Domain name of the DS-Lite address family transition router.

options.name: SOL_MAX_RT
options.description: Maximum retransmission timeout for Solicit messages.

options.name: INF_MAX_RT
options.description: Maximum retransmission timeout for Information-request messages.

options.name: Captive-Portal
options.description: URI of the network's captive portal API.
